rule_or_pattern: ^Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας$  (the arched university logo repeated on every slide)
notes: The catalogue title (a 1336 Venetian Crete deed) does not match the content: these are born-digital plant-biotechnology lecture slides. Body text and the English diagram labels are read correctly (1-22, 25, 26, 30, 31, 34-40), so the Latin share is genre. One describable subset is a poor training target: the university logo, set as tiny arched/curved text, recurs on almost every slide as the identical label 'Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας' (7 of 40 sampled lines: 23, 24, 27-29, 32, 33). The label is literally right, but it is a non-horizontal logo that would heavily overweight one string in a 51-line book.
